purpose: Frozen user-supplied GISTDA response inputs for the controlled prototype; no live API fetching or API credentials required
source_attribution: GISTDA; API responses supplied by the project owner

publication_permission.scope: Both raw response files on the public AutoTrace GitHub repository
publication_permission.note: The user confirmed permission under GISTDA terms to publish these responses. This records that attestation, not an independently verified blanket data license. Other assets/acquisitions require separate permission.

request_area_limit.note: The user corrected the previous unit error. Supplied query polygon planning areas are below 5 km2; API area method is not embedded in these responses. No new API requests are planned.

prototype_crop.selection_rule: Select the record by exact result label within its associated case response, never by filename, first element, or a combined union of all crop records

files.format: JSON array in a .txt file; not GeoJSON FeatureCollection

schema_observed.geom: array of GeoJSON Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry objects, each with type and coordinates
schema_observed.coordinate_interpretation: longitude, latitude in WGS84/EPSG:4326 assumed for the supplied GeoJSON geometry; review during implementation

missing_source_metadata: request geom/from/to and request or retrieval timestamp
meaning of update and per-geometry observation or season dates
provider CRS declaration and request-area measurement method
processing_requirements: Preserve raw files byte-for-byte; write derived geometry separately with source hashes
Validate actual response schema and geometry before selecting exact Maize record
Clip matched crop geometries to the associated canonical query AOI and union/deduplicate in EPSG:32647
Some supplied geometry crosses query AOI edges; do not assume it is already clipped
Polygon component counts are structural counts, not surveyed farm counts
Do not infer contemporaneous acreage/production by summing geometries or updates; explicitly review snapshot/date-composition semantics
update=2026-09-30 is source metadata, not a procurement period, acquisition time, harvest date, or burn date
Absent source fields remain unknown; no fabricated endpoint, area, yield or complete-coverage metadata
UC1/UC2 burnt/non-burnt names do not establish fire status; burn evidence and mock production remain separate
No live GISTDA fetching, API key, refresh, or WorldCereal fallback in the prototype
